The search combines two required concepts: depressive disorders and relapse/recurrence. Psychological theories and mechanisms were tested as an optional block and left out because only 7 relevant records were available to assess whether requiring that block would be safe.

The final search retrieved **17,169 records** through the requested 2018-11-17 PubMed entry-date cutoff. It retrieved all **7 of 7** screened development records; that is development relative recall, not independent validation or sensitivity. No seeds or held-out validation set were available. The optional-block loss sample found 0 relevant records among 30 screened, but that small sample does not establish safety.

I proceeded with the documented scope assumptions because you asked me not to pause for clarification. The full result set exceeds the standard 10,000-record screening budget, so the audit recommends screening all records in batches without truncating the set. The cutoff is an Entrez entry-date bound; no publication-date limit was added. This is a draft and needs PRESS peer review by an information specialist before use.
